title: Boolean sum over the true value
statement: For every nonnegative extended real number $p$, the sum over the true element of the Boolean set, restricted to the Boolean value that is true, of the weight that is $p$ at true and $1-p$ at false equals $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a nonnegative extended real number
